item.title: Student accelerator
item.description: The most important Garage activity. Selected student teams build their ideas in the accelerator programs.

item.title: Programming challenges and other competitions
item.description: Our faculty cooperates with different companies and works with them to prepare our students a number of different challenges. All students, who participate in one of the challenges can for the duration of the challenge use the premises of Garage for work.

item.title: Group brainstorming and BoF sessions
item.description: Brainstorming and BoF sessions are networking events with the aim to identify ideas that are then used in the Garage or in a group to learn any new technology.
